title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Forwarding the Opinion of the Civil Aviation Administration of China and Others on Regulating the Flow of Flight Personnel to Ensure the Stability of the Civil Aviation Flight Crew
keywords_en: contract dispute; labor contract; guarantee; labor dispute
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Forwarding the Opinions of the Civil Aviation Administration of China and Others on Regulating the Flow Management of Flight Personnel and Ensuring the Stability of the Civil Aviation Flight Crew

Fa Fa [2005] No. 13

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Given that the recent disputes over flight personnel in the civil aviation system seeking to dissolve labor contracts involve new types of issues arising from the reform of the civil aviation system and are of a special nature, and that the proper handling of such disputes is related to the safety of civil aviation flights and the protection of state-owned assets, for this reason, with the approval of the State Council, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, together with the Ministry of Personnel, the Ministry of Labor and Social Security, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, and the Legislative Affairs Office of the State Council, jointly issued on May 25, 2005, the "Opinions on Regulating the Flow Management of Flight Personnel and Ensuring the Stability of the Civil Aviation Flight Crew" (Min Hang Ren Fa [2005] No. 104, hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions") concerning the flow of flight personnel of public air transport enterprises.

The Opinions are hereby forwarded to your court. In trial work, please refer to the handling principles and the standard for calculating training expenses determined in the Opinions, earnestly carry out the supervision and guidance work concerning labor dispute cases arising from the dissolution of labor contracts by flight personnel, guide the people's courts at all levels within your jurisdiction to properly conduct ideological work with the parties involved in such disputes, strive to resolve conflicts and settle disputes through means such as mediation or withdrawal of lawsuits after reconciliation, so as to protect the legitimate rights and interests of flight personnel, safeguard state-owned assets and aviation safety, and achieve the unity of legal effect and social effect. New situations and new problems encountered in the trial of such cases shall be promptly reported to this court.

The notice is hereby given.

July 25, 2005

Civil Aviation Administration of China, Ministry of Personnel, Ministry of Labor and Social Security, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, Legislative Affairs Office of the State Council

Opinions on Regulating the Flow Management of Flight Personnel and Ensuring the Stability of the Civil Aviation Flight Crew

Min Hang Ren Fa [2005] No. 104

All regional administrations and airlines of civil aviation; all departments (bureaus) of labor and social security of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government:

In order to further regulate the flow management of civil aviation flight personnel, ensure the stability of the flight crew, and ensure flight safety, in response to the current contradiction between the rapid development of civil aviation and the shortage of flight personnel, and in line with the principles of improving industry regulations, cultivating market mechanisms, safeguarding legitimate rights and interests, and ensuring orderly flow according to law, with the approval of the State Council, the following opinions are hereby put forward regarding the flow of flight personnel of public air transport enterprises:

1. Regulate the employment practices of air transport enterprises according to law, and gradually establish and improve a mechanism for the orderly flow of flight personnel according to law. Air transport enterprises recruiting flight personnel shall comply with relevant laws and regulations, recruit openly from society. Where recruiting flight personnel currently employed by other air transport enterprises, they shall negotiate with the flight personnel and their current employer, and only after reaching consensus may they handle the relevant procedures, and shall pay compensation to the original employer in accordance with the actual costs of the current air transport enterprises for recruiting, training, and hiring flight personnel, with reference to the standard of RMB 700,000 to 2.1 million yuan. For flight personnel who have not terminated or dissolved the labor contract with their original employer, no new labor relationship shall be established and no labor contract shall be signed.

At the current stage, in order to ensure the normal production and operation of air transport enterprises and maintain the relative stability of the flight crew, taking into account the characteristics of air transport enterprises, flight personnel who resign shall submit an application for dissolution of the labor contract in advance, and shall, to the extent possible, handle the procedures for dissolving the labor contract during the off-peak transportation season. Where a flight individual requests dissolution of the labor contract, and the labor contract stipulates liability for breach of contract, the flight personnel shall bear the corresponding liability in accordance with the agreement.

2. Strengthen the management of labor contracts of air transport enterprises, and establish and improve relevant rules and regulations. The content of labor contracts shall be further improved, and the liability and standard for compensation for breaching the dissolution of the labor contract shall be clearly defined. The basic ledger management of labor contracts shall be strengthened, and the conclusion, performance, modification, and dissolution of labor contracts shall be carried out according to law. At the same time, through the establishment of a collective consultation and collective contract system, the legitimate rights and interests of both the enterprise and the employees shall be safeguarded, and the harmony and stability of labor relations shall be maintained.

3. Further deepen the reform of the wage distribution system of air transport enterprises, and stabilize the flight personnel team. Efforts shall be made to explore and establish a wage income distribution incentive mechanism that conforms to the characteristics of air transport enterprises, so that wage distribution is tilted towards front-line flight personnel, reasonably widening the wage income gap between flight personnel and general staff, and gradually establishing a salary system where the income of flight personnel is aligned with market prices and is competitively attractive. In-depth and meticulous ideological and political work shall be carried out, earnestly caring for the work and life of the vast majority of flight personnel, striving to solve their worries, stabilizing the flight personnel team, and ensuring the safety of civil aviation flights.

4. Further improve the flight access and qualification management of flight personnel. Civil aviation administrative authorities at all levels shall strengthen management according to law, strictly enforce the flight access system and qualification management for civil aviation flight personnel. For flight personnel who have not completed the procedures for termination or dissolution of the labor contract and related formalities with the original employer according to regulations, and who have not signed a labor contract with a new employer and have been grounded, their resumption of flight shall not be approved.

5. Increase the intensity of training civil aviation flight personnel, and actively explore the establishment of a market-oriented training mechanism. In response to the current relative shortage of civil aviation flight personnel, efforts shall be made to actively explore the establishment of multi-channel, multi-level, and diversified approaches for training civil aviation flight personnel. Adhere to the combination of academic education and vocational training, continue to strengthen the cooperation mechanism between air transport enterprises and domestic and foreign flight professional colleges and vocational training institutions. Make full use of the resources of existing flight professional colleges, increase the intensity of enterprise investment in targeted recruitment of pilots, and at the same time, appropriately introduce foreign flight personnel. Relevant policies and regulations shall be improved to encourage individuals to pay for their own training or through bank loans to participate in flight vocational training, gradually and fundamentally resolving the contradiction between supply and demand for flight personnel.

May 25, 2005
